title: hypenia pauliana
intro: Hypenia pauliana, commonly known as Brazilian plume poppy, is a plant species native to Brazil that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and fever, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hypenia pauliana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
